scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const src = path.join('node_modules', '@rollup', 'wasm-node', 'dist'); const dest = path.join('node_modules', 'rollup', 'dist'); if (fs.existsSync(src) && fs.existsSync(dest)) { fs.cpSync(path.join(src, 'wasm-node'), path.join(dest, 'wasm-node'), { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'native.js'), path.join(dest, 'native.js')); }"
